c74object.name: evi_rcfilter
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Trapezoidal nonliner onepole rc filter emulation
c74object.description:
evi_rcfilter is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_rcfilter.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
evi_rcfilter is also available in MSP as: evi.rcfilter~.
A basic analog building block. Efficient, nonlinear analog onepole filter using trapezoidal integration and newton-raphson loop. @see: evi_rcfilters.genexpr for details. A choice of frequency input in Hz (default) or normalised 0..1 (via the prewarp attribute). Optional smoothing is default off. @see: evi.onepole~ for a multimode linear version.

geninlet.name: hz
geninlet.digest: (default) or g depending on 'prewarp' attribute. We have a choice of frequency input in Hz (default) or normalised 0..1, depending on the @prewarp attribute. Optional smoothing (@smooth attribute) is default off.

attribute.name: prewarp
attribute.description: If on (defualt), the second inlet expects frequency in Hz and g coefficient warping is performed internally. If off, the second inlet expects a normalised g coefficient 0..1 and this is passed on directly to the filter internally.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing time of the internal g coefficient (via the second inlet). If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.
